title: Zesty Bitter Vietnamese Corn Cha Gio
description: A bitter, fluffy, and comforting Vietnamese dish featuring cornmeal and tandoor flavors, served in a crispy cha gio form
instructions: Preheat the tandoor or oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, mix together cornmeal, rice flour, and tandoor masala
Add diced bitter melon, coconut milk, and vegetable oil to the bowl and stir until a thick batter forms
Season the batter with salt and black pepper to taste
Using a cha gio mold or a spoon, shape the batter into small cylindrical shapes
Place the cha gio on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
Bake the cha gio for 20 minutes or until crispy and golden brown
Serve the Zesty Bitter Vietnamese Corn Cha Gio hot with your favorite dipping sauce
